title: 電動式の高圧洗浄機
description: 公共施設の外壁や舗装清掃シーン向けの小型洗浄機。車輪付き管フレーム、フィン付き電動機、ポンプ外装、固定ホース巻き、トリガーガンと長いランスを備えます。給水・電源・噴流、内部機構、実際の圧力・洗浄・走行はなく、安全性は未検証。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.533 × 1.195 × 0.550 m、14,356三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A small pressure-washer trolley for public-building wall and paving cleaning scenes, with tubular frame, finned electric motor, pump exterior, fixed hose coil, trigger gun and long lance. Supply water, mains power, spray, working internals, pressure, cleaning and rolling behavior are absent; real equipment safety is unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.533 × 1.195 × 0.550 m; 14,356 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
